description: Use to pay someone per second: the payee's share unlocks linearly, they can withdraw what has vested at any time, and you (the payer) can cancel and get the unvested rest back. Optional arbiter can pause and resume (never move funds). ETH or any ERC-20. Returns the (approve and) createStream transactions with calldata. No account, no signature.

amount.description: Total amount to stream in WHOLE units of the token, e.g. "100" (or 0.5 for ETH). Use amountRaw for atomic units.

amountRaw.description: Optional: total in the token's smallest unit as an integer string (wei for ETH, 6 decimals for USDC/USDG). Overrides amount.

arbiter.description: Optional third wallet that can pause and resume the stream. It can never move funds.

durationDays.description: Days until everything has vested. Or use durationSeconds.

durationSeconds.description: Seconds until everything has vested (1 second to 10 years).

payee.description: Wallet that receives the stream. Must differ from the payer.

payer.description: Wallet that funds the stream. It sends the (approve and) createStream transactions.

startAt.description: Optional unix time in the future. Default: starts now.

token.description: Leave out or "ETH" = native ETH (the default on BOTH chains). "usdg" (Robinhood Chain), "usdc" (Base) or any ERC-20 address.

name: bull_stream_create
